steps.what: Show the customer problem or need already logged.
Provide feedback to design engineers on customer problems.

tasks.design: The {HELPDESK} shows the customer problem or need already logged. The mechanical engineer provides the feedback to the design engineers. The logged problem is not that feedback. A problem with no customer leaves the conversation with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A problem title was forwarded as the feedback, and the design engineers still did not know the need.
tasks.enabler_now: The logged problem can be opened. The feedback still takes the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A need the ticket does not name still has to be said by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer gives the feedback. The ticket is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The feedback stays in the conversation with the design engineers. The logged problem is not that feedback.

reach.task: Hear the customer problem from the mechanical engineer.
reach.learn: A ticket title is not the feedback.

evidence.claim: Opening a logged customer problem is a lookup. It does not provide feedback to the design engineers.
A stored title is not the conversation about what the customer needs.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The problem id only if it is already logged. Feedback text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the problem on the service desk before the conversation.
unknowns: Whether customer needs and customer problems share one log.
research_questions: Who confirms the problem still matches what the customer said?

already_counted.description: Giving the feedback stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop problems whose customer conversation has already been held.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still provides feedback to the design engineers on the customer problem or need. Only opening a problem that was already logged is removed. A title saves none of that conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Write performance requirements from held product development notes.

loop.input: a note id and one sentence from that note
loop.output: a sentence kept only when that note states it
loop.check: The sentence cites a note id and the note text contains it.
loop.stop: Stop when there is no note id, or the note does not state the sentence. The engineer writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot tell which sentence is absent from the held development note, so it would present a requirement the note does not state.

steps.what: Accept the performance requirements and write any missing sentence.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store keeps a sentence in the performance requirements only when a held product development or engineering note states it, and every number must trace to that note. The mechanical engineer writes any missing sentence and accepts the text. Only that accepted version is filed. A sentence the note does not state is left for the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A requirement named a performance number that was not in the note it cited.
tasks.enabler_now: A held note can supply a sentence it actually states. The requirements still have to be accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A performance the note does not state still has to be written by the engineer, or left out.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer writes the missing sentences and accepts the requirements. A quoted note is not the requirement.
tasks.altitude: The requirements are accepted by the engineer before they are filed. Quoted note text is only a draft.

reach.task: Design to performance requirements this engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A quoted note is not the requirement.

evidence.claim: A sentence may be kept only when a development note the company already holds states it, and a number must trace to that note.
Filing the requirements before the engineer accepts that version would store a performance nobody set.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: A note id and the sentence on that note. A number with no note id is not kept. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the development note from the document store before writing the requirements.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether product development notes and engineering project notes share one record type.
research_questions: Which notes may be quoted into a performance requirement?

already_counted.description: Writing missing sentences and accepting the requirements stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop requirement sentences whose source note has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: requirements version and the note ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still writes any sentence the note does not state and still accepts the performance requirements. The draft may repeat only a sentence a held note states, every number must trace to a note, and only that accepted version is filed. A silent note saves none of the writing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Estimate costs from stored quantity and price on each line.
Submit bids for engineering, construction, or extraction projects.
Send the accepted bid for that engineering project.

tasks.design: The {ERP} multiplies a stored quantity by a stored price for each bid line. The mechanical engineer writes the bid for the engineering, construction, or extraction project and accepts it. A missing price stops that line, and no price is invented. The {EMAIL} send goes out only for the version the engineer accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: A bid total was sent from a price that had not been checked against the supplier total.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and a stored price can be multiplied. The bid still has to be written and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: A project the price table does not cover still has to be priced by the engineer, or left out of the bid.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer writes and accepts the bid. The line cost is arithmetic, and the send uses only that accepted version.
tasks.altitude: The bid stays with the engineer until that version is accepted. Only then is it sent.

reach.task: Keep the price that was checked against the supplier total.
reach.learn: A multiplied line is not the bid.

evidence.claim: Quantity times a stored price is arithmetic. It does not write the bid or decide what the project includes.
Sending a bid before the engineer accepts that version would put a price nobody stood behind in front of the customer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: Quantity and price, both already stored on the line. A quote amount only when a stored total already equals it. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the price from the buying record before multiplying. Do not type a second price.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the mechanical engineer.
unknowns: Whether construction bids and extraction bids share one price table.
research_questions: Who checks a supplier total before the price is stored?

already_counted.description: Writing and accepting the bid stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop prices whose supplier record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: project id, line prices, and the bid text the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still writes the bid and still accepts the version that is sent. Only multiplying a stored quantity by a stored price, and sending the version already accepted, is removed. A missing price saves none of the bid, and no price is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the production schedule and the method already selected.
Develop or monitor production, including manufacturing method selection.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} record shows the production schedule and any manufacturing method already selected. The mechanical engineer develops, coordinates, or monitors production, including fabrication and the operation of the product design. The schedule does not select the method. A schedule with no product id leaves the work with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A method was treated as selected because it was the last one stored, and this product had not been considered.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored schedule can be opened. The development, coordination, and monitoring still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A fabrication problem the schedule does not show still has to be handled by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer selects and monitors. The schedule is the record already stored.
tasks.altitude: Production decisions stay with the engineer. The stored schedule does not select the method.

reach.task: Run the method this engineer has selected for this product.
reach.learn: The last stored method is not a selection.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored schedule is a lookup. It does not develop, coordinate, or monitor production, and it does not select a manufacturing method.
Treating the last stored method as the selection would skip the engineer's decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A mechanical engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the machine, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The schedule id and the product id already stored. The screen does not select a manufacturing method. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the mechanical engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the schedule on the project record before the production review.
unknowns: Whether fabrication choices and operating methods share one schedule.
research_questions: Who is allowed to store a method against a product before the engineer reviews it?

already_counted.description: Developing, coordinating, and monitoring production stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop schedule rows whose product has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops, coordinates, or monitors production, including the selection of the manufacturing method. Only opening a schedule already stored is removed. The schedule saves none of that selection.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The mechanical engineer still tells the design engineers what the customer needs, still writes the performance requirements, still stands behind a bid, and still watches production. A stored note can be opened. It is not the decision.
reach: Design engineers hear customer feedback from this engineer, and a ticket is not that feedback.
Estimators read a bid only after this engineer has accepted the prices in it.
skills_to_grow: Give customer feedback in the conversation, not from a problem title.
Keep a requirement sentence only when the held note states it.
Submit a bid only after the prices in it are ones the engineer accepts.
role.ambitious_version: Feedback, performance requirements, bids, and production decisions stay with the engineer. Stored notes and price lines only show what was already recorded.
